snippet.title: One Tower Defense - Prerelease Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4138190/One_Tower_Defense/

One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.
